# Twins Consulting Group (TCG)

> Twins Consulting Group is a property and land consultancy based in Kuta, Bali, Indonesia. It legalizes Bali properties for short-term rental and manages them, and it develops monetization strategies for land holdings in Indonesia.

## Services

- [Bali villa legalization and rental](https://twinsconsulting.group/): Legal and operational setup for Bali properties entering the short-term rental market: zoning review, building approvals, business licensing and compliance, from property audit to first legal booking. Properties are operated under the licence of one of 30+ licensed local management companies TCG partners with. The owner keeps full ownership. Management fee: 25% (covers day-to-day management, on-site staff and launch photography). Minimum contract term: one year. Owner payouts: monthly, in USD or EUR. Focus: properties with the potential to generate at least US$500 per booked night.
- [Land monetization strategy](https://twinsconsulting.group/land): Assessment, highest and best use analysis, monetization roadmap and investor positioning for land holdings in Indonesia. For landowners and institutional investors.

## Guide

- [Bali Villa Regulations 2026](https://twinsconsulting.group/regulations): Source-based guide to Bali villa legality: zoning (RDTR, RTRW, KKPR, ITBX), PBG, SLF, legacy IMB, NIB, KBLI and OSS, PT PMA rules and the 18 closed categories, operator structures, local tax, 2026 changes, and the legalization route for existing villas. Links to official Indonesian government sources.
